commits.summary: Fix Phase 2: 4 critical auth regressions found in code review
Fix Phase 2 review findings: org-wide access, CSRF flow, authorizationService
Fix CSRF session-binding: refresh token after login
Fix Phase 2: org-wide patient list + photo route clarification

reviewCorrections.finding: sessionAuthMiddleware blocked the login route (self-referential deadlock)
cookie-parser not mounted before CSRF middleware
Absolute session timeout not enforced (only idle)
authorize() applied facility check even for org-wide identities
Logout did not send X-CSRF-Token header
CSRF token not re-fetched after login (bound to pre-auth session ID)
listPatients called with facilityId for org-wide users (too narrow)
8 MB body-parser comment implied Phase 2 photo upload (clarified as Phase 3)
